finding.rationale: Reading sign-in logs via GET /auditLogs/signIns gives an adversary visibility into the authentication telemetry the defending team uses to detect anomalies. With the full sign-in record an adversary can identify low-detection windows (periods of low sign-in volume), correlate failed then succeeded sign-ins to infer detection thresholds, and determine which accounts generate security alerts — then operate through accounts that do not. AuditLog.Read.All is gated by the Reports Reader role or higher; restricting Reports Reader assignments to designated security operations accounts reduces the number of compromised credential paths that expose authentication telemetry to an adversary.
